unesco-decision-37com8b33.title: Decision 37 COM 8B.33 — Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe
unesco-decision-37com8b33.notes: Authoritative inscription decision. It states that all water features except the New Waterfall remain operable, so New Waterfall is preserved as surviving but non-functional rather than treated as an active Wasserspiele station.

stadt-lac.title: Wasserspiele Station 7 — Lac
stadt-lac.notes: Primary current nomenclature source: water flows from the Fontänenteich to the Schlossteich called the Lac; the Lac was formed from a small fish pond in 1785–1791 under Heinrich Christoph Jussow.
